objective: Determine whether the store carries the Heco TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw with screw type drywall screw.

params.product_lookup_method: Use normalized case-insensitive tokenized matching (ILIKE) on product_variants: brand ILIKE '%Heco%', series ILIKE '%TopFix%', model ILIKE '%GTU-YPJ%', product_name ILIKE '%Wood%Drywall%Screw%', and join product_variant_properties to check property_key = 'screw type' and property_value_text ILIKE '%drywall screw%'. Return the first matching product_sku and record_path.
